meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段脚本变成发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段脚本,却需要一支发布视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or script into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have only a product link or script but need a launch video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把产品或营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简介，按步骤做成产品发布/宣传视频，最终在 videos/<项目>/ 下渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想要推广、发布或揭晓一款产品时触发；任何商业网址默认走这里，网站导览/展示类需求也归它。

say.text: 给我们的新功能做一支发布视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a product or marketing URL, a pasted script, or a brief into a product launch/promo video, working step by step in videos/<project>/ and rendering a final video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, or reveal a product; it is also the default for any commercial URL, and site tours or showcases of a website route here too.
